scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @kajo/mobile && npm run lint --workspace @kajo/prediction-engine && npm run lint --workspace @kajo/catalog-contracts && npm run lint --workspace @kajo/description-acceptance
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @kajo/mobile && npm run typecheck --workspace @kajo/prediction-engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @kajo/description-acceptance
scripts.test:edge: deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json --frozen supabase/functions/*/index.ts supabase/functions/entrypoints.test.ts && deno test --config supabase/functions/deno.json --frozen --cached-only --no-prompt --allow-net=127.0.0.1 supabase/functions/entrypoints.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:mobile && npm run test:catalog && npm run test:edge && npm run test:database && npm run test:engine && npm run test:research && npm run test:acceptance
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:ios --workspace @kajo/mobile && npm run smoke:android --workspace @kajo/mobile && npm run smoke --workspace @kajo/description-acceptance
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run smoke
scripts.test:research: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/research -p "test_*.py" && node --test scripts/research/*.test.mjs
